reservation_ttl_minutes.title: Reservation lifetime (minutes)
reservation_ttl_minutes.description: A reserved code is held for this long; unconfirmed reservations then expire and give their uses back.

confirm_expired.title: Confirm a late order if the use is still available
confirm_expired.description: An order completed after its reservation expired is redeemed when the code can still be claimed.

release_on_cancel.title: Give uses back when an order is cancelled

release_on_refund.title: Give uses back on refunds
release_on_refund.description: never, full (once the refunds reach the order total) or any refund.
